description: This file defines the SeoTransform class, which implements a FreeMarker template transformation for processing URLs (links) in the context of SEO optimization. It provides URL rewriting with regex patterns, handling URL parameters such as session IDs, and generates SEO-friendly URLs.

classes.name: SeoTransform
classes.description: A FreeMarker transform class for URL rewriting and SEO optimization, implementing the TemplateTransformModel interface.

methods.name: checkArg
methods.description: Checks a boolean argument from the args map, returning a default value if not present.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Returns a Writer that processes the body of the transform, producing transformed URLs based on request context and URL rules.

methods.name: seoUrl
methods.description: Transforms a URL into an SEO-friendly version using regex patterns, considering session ID parameters and anonymous visitor configurations.
